texts.preamble: Prem Pradeep vs Anuj Sharma on 14 November, 2025 :1: In The Court Of Ms. Charu Gupta Presiding Officer, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-01 (Se), Saket Courts : New Delhi Mact No. 410/2019 Prempradeep vs. Anuj Sharma & ors. Cnr No: Dlse01-003849-2019 1. Prem Pradeep S/o Mahendra Thakur R/o F-24/441, F-block Molarband, Badarpur, New Delhi. ..........Petitioner Versus 1. Anuj Sharma S/o Sh. O P Sharma R/o 67A, Rampuram Shyam Ps Chakeri, Distt. Kanpur Nagar, U.P. ............Driver/Respondent no.1 2. Madhu Singh W/o Sh. Dhirendra Kumar Singh R/o 32/1, Sanuog Chhetri Vihar Colony, Cantt. Lucknow, U.P.226002. ............Owner/Respondent no.2 3. New India Assurance Company Ltd. Office at: 10th floor, Scope Minar Laxmi Nagar, Delhi-110092 ............ Insurance company/Respondent no.3 Mact no. 410/2019 Prem Pradeep vs. Anuj Sharma & ors. Page No. 1 of 26 ss Digitally signed by Charu Charu Gupta Gupta Date: 2025.11.14 16:57:05 +0530 Date of accident : 10.08.2017 Result of accident : Grievous/permanent disability Date of filing of Petition : 29.05.2019 Date of Decision : 14.11.2025 Award 1.
texts.facts: The present claim petition arises out of road accident in which one Sh. Prem Pradeep, aged about 32 years suffered grievous injury. An application u/s 166(1) Motor Vehicle Act was accordingly filed by the claimant/applicant. 2. Brief facts of the case are that on 10.08.2017, petitioner Prem Pradeep along with Prem Pradeep vs Anuj Sharma on 14 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73182952/ 1 one Dinesh Kumar and one friend Vipin, was returning to Noida, Distt. Gautam Budh Nagar from Lucknow by car bearing no.UP-16BF-1238. The car was being driven by Dinesh Kumar. At about 03:30 p.m. when they reached near Village Piproli, Highway, PS Thathiya, Distt. Kannauj, U.P, the tyre of the car got punctured. The car was stopped and parked at a side of the road. Petitioner and Dinesh got down from the car to check the tyre, when suddenly, a Scorpio car bearing no.UP-32ES-5735 (hereinafter referred to as the offending vehicle), came from behind and hit the petitioner and Dinesh Kumar with a great force. Due to the impact, Dinesh died on the spot while petitioner sustained grievous injury. He was immediately rushed to Tirrya Medical College where first aid given to him. He was then referred to Regency Hospital, A-2, Sarvodaya Nagar, Kanpur, where he remained hospitalized from 10.08.2017 to 27.09.2017. He was taken to MAX Super Speciality Hospital, Saket where he underwent treatment from MACT no. 410/2019 Prem Pradeep vs. Anuj Sharma & ors. Page No. 2 of 26 ss Digitally signed by CHARU CHARU GUPTA GUPTA Date: 2025.11.14 16:57:10 +0530 27.09.2017 to 12.10.2017. Thereafter he was admitted in Jai Prakash Narayan Apex Trauma center (AIIMS), New Delhi from 25.01.2018 to 27.01.2018. He was taken to Indraprastha Apollo Hospital, Sarita Vihar, Mathura Road, Delhi where he remained under treatment from 29.08.2018 to 01.09.2018. 3. An FIR no.0291/2017, dated 10.08.2017 was registered u/s 279, 338, 304A of IPC at PS Thathia, Distt-Kannauj, U.P. Matter was investigated and a chargesheet was filed u/s 279/338/304A of IPC before concerned criminal court while separate claim petition was filed before this Tribunal. 4. Respondent no.1 is the driver, respondent no. 2 is the owner of the offending vehicle. Respondent no.3 is the insurer of the offending vehicle. 5. No Written statement or reply was filed on behalf of Respondent no.1 & 2 despite opportunity. Respondent no.3/insurance company filed its reply denying compensation to the petitioner on the ground that the accident occurred due to sole negligence of the petitioner who had negligently parked his vehicle on the road which was an express highway. Negligence on the part of the offending vehicle has been denied. Though, insurance policy is not denied, liability is refuted in case respondents were found to be in breach of the terms of the insurance policy. 6. Vide order dated 29.09.2020, following issues were framed. 1. Whether the injured suffered injuries in a road traffic accident on 10.08.2017 due to rash and negligent driving of vehicle no. UP-32ES-5735 being driven by R1, owned by MACT no. 410/2019 Prem Pradeep vs. Anuj Sharma & ors. Page No. 3 of 26 ss Digitally signed by CHARU CHARU GUPTA GUPTA OPP 2. Whether the injured is entitled to compensation, if so, to what extent and from whom? OPP. 3. Relief. 7. In order to prove his claim, petitioner examined Sh.Gagan Chandra Bag, Deputy Manager Billing, Indraprastha Apollo Hospital, New Delhi as PW-1, Smt. Urmila (mother of petitioner) as PW2 (inadvertently noted as PW-3) and Sh. Vipin (eye witness) as PW3 (inadvertently noted as PW-4). Sh. Gagan Chandra Bag, Deputy Manager Billing, Indraprastha Apollo Hospital examined as PW1. He deposed that he was a summoned witness. He has been authorized by the said hospital. Copy of his ID card as Ex.PW1/A. He brought original discharge summary of injured Prem Pradeep. Same was Ex.PW1/1. Original medical bills of injured as Ex.PW1/2 and refund receipt as Ex.PW1/3. PW1 was duly cross examined by learned counsel for insurance company. Smt. Urmila Devi filed her evidence by way of affidavit as Ex.PW3/A. She deposed on the lines of the claim petition and stated that she is mother of petitioner Prem Pradeep. She deposed that on 10.08.2017, her son Prem Pradeep along with his driver Dinesh Kumar and his relative Vipin were coming to Delhi from Lucknow by Car no. UP16BF-1238 which was being driven by Dinesh Kumar. At about 3:30 pm,when the car reached near Village Piproli, its tyre got punctured. While the car was parked on the correct side of the road and the tyres were being checked by son of PW2 and the driver, a Scorpio car bearing MACT no. 410/2019 Prem Pradeep vs. Anuj Sharma & ors. Page No. 4 of 26Digitally ss signed by CHARU CHARU GUPTA GUPTA Date: 2025.11.14 16:57:17 +0530 no.UP32ES-5735 came driven at a high speed in a rash and negligent manner and hit the petitioner and Dinesh Kumar. Due to the impact, Dinesh suffered fatal injury while petitioner sustained grievous injury and was diagnosed with traumatic head injury tracheostomised left side decompressive craniotomy with VP shunt seizure disorder, UTI and LRT-I. She deposed that her son was taken to Tirrya Medical College from where he was referred to Regency Hospital. He was then taken to Max Super specialty hospital from where he was taken to AIIMS trauma center and lastly received treatment from Indraprastha Apollo Hospital. She deposed that the victim was still undergoing treatment. PW2 further deposed that her son had suffered 100% permanent disability and had been rendered vegetative due to the injuries. She deposed that a sum of Rs.50 lacs had been incurred on his medical treatment, Rs.50,000/- on his special diet, Rs.50,000/- on his conveyance and Rs.1 lac on attendant. PW-2 deposed that her son was 32 years of age at the time of accident and was serving as director in the name of ABU Infracone Pvt.Ltd. He was earning Rs.9,24,838/- per annum. 3 PW-2 relied upon medical treatment records of the petitioner as Ex.PW3/1, medical treatment bills of the petitioner as Ex.PW3/2, permanent disability certificate issued by AIIMS Hospital as Ex.PW3/3, marksheet of 2003 issued by Bihar Intermediate Education Council, grade sheet (1st semester to 7th semester) of B.tech issued by JP University of Information Technology as Ex.PW3/4, PAN card of the petitioner as Ex.PW3/5, Adhar card of the petitioner as Ex.PW3/6, Adhar card MACT no. 410/2019 PW-3/Sh. Vipin was examined as an eye witness who tendered his evidence by way of affidavit as Ex.PW4/A. PW-3 deposed that on 10.08.2017, he along with his friend Dinesh Kumar and Sh. Prem Pradeep were coming to Noida from Lucknow by a car UP-16BF-1238 which was being driven by Dinesh Kumar at a normal speed and in correct lane. At about 03:30 p.m. when they reached near Village Piproli, Highway, PS Thathiya, Distt. Kannauj, the tyre of the car got punctured and driver Dinesh Kumar stopped his car on correct side of the road. Prem Pradeep and Dinesh Kumar got down from the car and was in process of checking the tyre, in the meanwhile a Scorpio car bearing no.UP-32ES-5735, came from back side and hit the Prem Pal and his driver with a great force. Due to the impact, Prem Pal sustained grievous injury. He was immediately taken to Tirrva Medical College where first aid given to him. He relied upon his Adhar card as Mark A. PW3 was duly cross examined by learned counsel for insurance company. No evidence was led on behalf of the respondents. 8. Final arguments in detail were addressed by all the parties. Page No. 6 of 26 ss Digitally signed by CHARU CHARU GUPTA GUPTA (ii) Loss of amenities or loss of Already granted expectation of life span on account of disability : (iii) Percentage of loss of earning Already granted capacity in relation to disability: (iv) Loss of future Income: As already decided, principal award amount/ compensation will be payable by insurance company with simple interest @7.5% p.a. from the date of filing of petition till actual realization. In compliance of directions issued vide order dated 16.11.2021 by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Writ Petition Civil No.534/2020 titled as Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Pvt. Ltd. Vs. Union of India the award amount shall be deposited with State Bank of India, Saket Court Branch, New Delhi by way of RTGS/NEFT/IMPS in account of MACT SAVING ACCOUNT No. 00000042706875094, IFS Code SBIN0014244 and MICR code 110002342 under intimation to the Nazir in the prescribed format i.e. MCOP Number on the file of (Claims Tribunal Name) Date of award, Compensation Amount, Income Tax Deduction at Source, Bank Transaction Reference No./Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) Number.
